inspiration: Per-creature sound kits: each creature has its own synth folder with one short sound per action (attack, hit, death), so the species is recognisable by ear. Refs: data/src/synth/npc/bat/ and the 38 entries under data/src/synth/npc/.

Shared rig, many poses: all 226 base and 7391 frame files sit under data/src/models/_unpack, suggesting one rig per body type with many short animation poses. Recreate with our own rig. Ref: data/src/models/_unpack/.

Recolour variants: NPC configs change colours by pairs of palette entries and reuse one animation set, so one body gives several liveries cheaply. Ref: data/src/scripts/areas/area_edgeville/configs/edgeville.npc (block [generalshopkeeper5]). No numbers copied.

Modular UI panels: panels built from many small PNG pieces (backbase, backleft, backright names) plus a fixed-cell bitmap font atlas. A 9-slice-style panel and fixed-cell font are an easy original build. Refs: data/src/sprites/, data/src/fonts/p12.png.

Small repeating material tiles: 64x64 texture tiles (chainmail, bark, canvas, darkwood names) show a cheap low-res material set for armour and wood. Ref: data/src/textures/chainmail.png (content not viewed).
Reward stingers: one short music cue per skill advance, kept apart from looping area themes. Refs: data/src/jingles/ (advance-<skill> files) and data/src/songs/.
Place-name labels as plain data: a text list drives map labels, separate from map geometry. Ref: data/src/maps/labels.txt (positions not reproduced).
